summary: Master the art of Solution Selling in Competitive Markets. Our training equips you with essential skills to drive sales and build lasting client relationships.
lede: Solution selling training helps sales professionals move from pitching offerings to addressing buyers’ business problems. It is designed for sales teams, account managers, business developers and consultants who need to differentiate beyond price, with practice in uncovering root causes, qualifying opportunities and linking solutions to measurable outcomes. Participants also work on stakeholder alignment, value justification, objection handling and outcome-focused proposals.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals who operate in highly competitive markets and need to differentiate themselves beyond price.
modules: Solution Selling Foundations in Competitive Markets
Buyer Psychology and Competitive Decision Making
Discovery That Actually Changes the Deal
Building a Business Case and Value Justification
Handling Objections, Price Pressure, and Comparisons
Closing Competitive Deals and Securing Commitment
Account Growth Through Ongoing Value Delivery
Personal Sales Operating System for Competitive Markets
prerequisites: Participants should have basic sales experience and an understanding of core sales concepts. Familiarity with B2B sales processes is beneficial but not mandatory.
